sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', checked_at) AS hour,
  component,
  count(*) AS total_checks,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_healthy = false) AS unhealthy_checks,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_healthy = false) / count(*), 2) AS unhealthy_rate_pct,
  round(avg(latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms
FROM system_health_checks
WHERE checked_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-28 12:00:00'
  AND checked_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-28 18:00:00'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY hour ASC, component ASC
note: system_health_checks is not tenant-scoped in this report (it tracks internal platform components, not merchant data), so results are aggregated across all tenants per hour/component as requested.
